subject: POC timeline & milestones — Acme Industries (post-call recap)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Reynolds <sofia.reynolds@acme-industries.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-industries.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC timeline & milestones — Acme Industries (post-call recap)

Hi Sofia / Liam —

Great to meet you both on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the PoC: 

Summary of discussion:
- Objective: validate Redwood's private deployment for low-latency inference of customer support routing and contextual summarization across 3 product lines.
- Primary success criteria (high level):
  1) 95th percentile latency <= 120ms for 512-token requests under expected batch sizes
  2) Model quality: F1 improvement >= 12 points on intent classification eval set and human-rated summaries >= 4/5 relevance
  3) Operational: automated KV caching reduces token cost by >= 25% vs baseline

Proposed PoC plan & timeline (please confirm availability):
- Week 0 (kickoff): May 31 — project kickoff, infra checklist, access & credentials, and finalize success criteria doc
- Weeks 1-3 (integration): Jun 1-21 — dataset ingest, routing rules, and baseline metrics capture
- Weeks 4-5 (optimization): Jun 22-Jul 5 — quantization/profile tuning, batching config, and latency regressions testing
- Week 6 (readout): Jul 12 — final readout + go/no-go decision with metrics and recording

Ownership & points of contact:
- Redwood: Marissa (AM / PoC lead), Rishi (runtime/ops), Dylan (solution engineering)
- Acme: Sofia (product lead), Liam (engineering lead), eng-eval (test coordinators)

Immediate next steps I can action this week:
1) Send a draft Mutual Action Plan (attached) and a Success Criteria spreadsheet for your review (attached).
2) Schedule the kickoff for May 31 — please share preferred time windows next week.
3) Share initial access instructions for a staging VPC and brief infra checklist.

Let me know any edits to the timeline or if you want to compress the schedule — we can push harder but will call out risks to SLA/quality.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: PoC_Success_Criteria.xlsx; Mutual_Action_Plan.docx

From: Sofia Reynolds <sofia.reynolds@acme-industries.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-industries.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, eng-eval <eng-eval@acme-industries.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC timeline & milestones — Acme Industries (post-call recap)

Thanks Marissa — this is great and matches what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side after syncing with the product and infra teams: 

Success criteria adjustments:
- Latency: can we make the SLO 95th <= 150ms for initial run, with target 120ms by optimization phase? Our infra has some NAT gateway variability in staging.
- Model quality: we'll provide the labeled intent eval set (approx 2k rows) by EOD Monday; for human-rated summaries we'll target the 4/5 threshold but want to define the rubric together.
- Cost reduction: 20% target for initial readout (we can commit to 25% if we get batching in prod-like conditions).

Timeline notes: May 31 kickoff works for our schedules — preferred time window 10:00-12:00 PT. We may need a short pre-kickoff security review (30 min) with our infosec folks on May 28 — can Rishi join?

Actions from Acme:
- Deliver eval dataset by 2027-05-24 17:00 PT
- Confirm staging VPC access and test account by 2027-05-26

We reviewed the attached MAP and success criteria doc — will send redlines tomorrow. Thanks for drafting.

Best,
Sofia Reynolds
Senior Product Manager | Acme Industries
sofia.reynolds@acme-industries.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Reynolds <sofia.reynolds@acme-industries.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC timeline & milestones — Acme Industries (post-call recap)

Sofia — thanks for the quick responses and the timeline clarifications. I can join the security pre-check on May 28 at 11:00 PT — confirming availability.

On latency SLOs: happy to accept the conservative 150ms baseline for the initial run; we'll treat 120ms as the stretch goal to hit by the optimization window. I'll also add a short section to the MAP on known staging constraints and mitigation steps (NAT/egress variability, batch sizing guidance).

I'll also share the staging access checklist and a minimal profiling agent we ask your infra team to run prior to the kickoff (should take <30 minutes). Expect the checklist link shortly via Google Drive.

Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
